name: Gold Pride - Eliminator
card_text: If your LP are lower than your opponent's: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can banish 1 other "Gold Pride" monster from your hand, face-up field, or GY; Special Summon 1 "Gold Pride Token" (Machine/DARK/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the same Level as that banished monster, also this card cannot be used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Summon this turn, except for a "Gold Pride" monster. You can only use each effect of "Gold Pride - Eliminator" once per turn.
